summary: This regulation explains what a recognized stock exchange must do with certain audit reports it receives. Specifically, it requires the stock exchange to review the Statement on Impact of Audit Qualifications and the annual audit report. Because the provided text is very short and lacks details on how or when to do this, it is not possible to fully explain the entire process from this text alone.
points: The recognised stock exchange must review the Statement on Impact of Audit Qualifications.
The recognised stock exchange must review the accompanying annual audit report.
These documents must be the ones submitted under specific clauses of regulations 33 and 52.
example: Asha Fashions Limited submitted its annual audit report along with the Statement on Impact of Audit Qualifications to the National Stock Exchange, as required by the listing rules. Upon receiving these documents, the staff at the National Stock Exchange opened the files to begin their review of the submitted Statement on Impact of Audit Qualifications and the accompanying annual audit report. They checked the papers to ensure they matched the specific rules mentioned in regulations 33 and 52, fulfilling their duty under the regulation to review these exact documents.
